d: Addressing students and families, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay hit out at alleged corruption in the state's education sector, saying irregularities involving school safety—recalling the Kumbakonam school tragedy—and public libraries cannot be ignored. Pointing specifically to alleged irregularities in the Coimbatore Periyar Arivulagam project involving AI technology, Vijay questioned whether other major library projects in Trichy, Salem, Tirunelveli, and Cuddalore would also show similar lapses.
